title: Network Delay Time: Settle the Earliest Arrival
summary: Dijkstra settles servers in order of arrival time: a min-heap of candidates, a table of best times, and stale entries skipped.

takeaway.summary: Pop the closest unsettled node from a min-heap and settle it; relax its outgoing edges, pushing a neighbor only when the new distance is shorter. Skip popped entries for settled nodes.
whenToUse: Shortest paths or earliest arrival with non-negative edge weights
Weighted graphs where BFS's hop count isn't the cost

scenes.narration: Five servers, joined by one-way links that each take a few milliseconds. Server 1 sends a message at time 0. When does the last server hear it?
scenes.caption: Server 1 broadcasts; each link takes its own time

scenes.narration: Trying every route explodes, and plain BFS counts hops, not milliseconds. Dijkstra settles servers in order of arrival time instead.
scenes.caption: Every route is too many; BFS counts hops, not time

scenes.narration: A min-heap holds candidate times, earliest on top. Server 1 starts at 0, so it's settled first.
scenes.caption: Pop server 1 at time 0: the starting point

scenes.narration: Server 3 settles at 1. Its link to server 2 makes 3 milliseconds, sooner than the direct 4, so the table updates and (3, 2) joins the heap.
scenes.caption: Via server 3, server 2 hears it at 3, sooner than 4

scenes.narration: Server 2 settles at 3. That's safe: every link adds non-negative time, so any other route to server 2 passes through a server already at least 3 away and can't arrive sooner.
scenes.caption: Pop (3, 2): server 2 settles at 3 for good

scenes.narration: Later the old entry (4, 2) comes out, but server 2 is done, so it's stale and skipped.
scenes.caption: (4, 2) is stale: server 2 already settled at 3

scenes.narration: Server 4 settles at 5. Going on to server 3 would take 6, not sooner than 1.
scenes.caption: From server 4, server 3 would take 6: it already has 1

scenes.narration: Server 5 settles at 6. The heap is empty; the last arrival is 6.
scenes.caption: Server 5 settles at 6, the last arrival

scenes.narration: That's Dijkstra: settle the closest node, relax its links, skip stale entries. With non-negative weights it runs in O(E log E) time.
scenes.caption: Dijkstra: settle the closest, then relax its links
